items.title: Boeing Gets 737, 787 Orders From China, Malaysia
items.summary: Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) on Wednesday disclosed that Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) plans to place its first order for 787 Dreamliner aircraft, selecting the largest variant, the 787-10. The proposed purchase includes 10 aircraft, with an option to acquire six additional planes, subject to finalization. items.title: Archer Aviation (ACHR) Plans Insitu Deal That Could Recast Its Defense Story
items.summary: Archer Aviation (NYSE:ACHR) plans to acquire Boeing's defense drone subsidiary Insitu, expanding beyond its core urban air taxi focus. The deal would make Boeing the largest shareholder in Archer Aviation through a mix of equity and other consideration tied to Insitu. Insitu brings an established portfolio of military drone contracts, adding ongoing defense revenue streams to Archer's primarily pre-commercial operations. items.title: China eyes mergers, tougher rules to help struggling airlines, SCMP says
items.summary: Nov 25 () - China's civil aviation regulator is weighing mergers and restructuring for smaller loss-making carriers ‌among options for sector consolidation from next year, ‌the South China Morning Post said on Wednesday, citing industry insiders. The plan, ​still being drafted, aims to speed a multi-year effort to improve profitability, which can affect airline procurement decisions, including demand for new jets from Boeing and Airbus, the newspaper ‌said.
